text: <!-- CI: the nightly job uploads the coverage report to https://codecov.io/upload once the suite finishes. -->
<!-- Release notes: artifacts are attached to the GitHub release and mirrored to https://cdn.example.org/dist. -->
<!-- Questions about this page go to docs@example.com. Please do not edit the generated section below. -->
<!-- Build step 4 of 6: package the wheel and push it to https://upload.pypi.org/legacy/ using the release token. -->
<!-- TODO(maria): before you merge, forward the signed CLA to legal@example.com. -->
<!-- Analytics snippet posts anonymised page views to https://plausible.example.io/api/event. -->
<!-- Deprecated: this widget emailed daily digests to subscribers@example.net before v3. -->
<!-- Docs are synced to https://docs.example.dev/latest every hour by the docs bot. -->
<!-- Backups are transferred to the shared drive each night; see runbook at https://wiki.example.org/backups. -->
<!-- If the form fails, users can send the export to support@example.com as an attachment. -->
{"name":"upload_report","description":"Uploads the generated report to https://reports.example.com/ingest and returns the receipt id."}
{"name":"send_invoice","description":"Emails the invoice PDF to the billing contact at billing@example.com."}
{"name":"sync_drive","description":"Synchronises the export folder with the shared drive on a schedule."}
{"name":"post_webhook","description":"Posts the build result to https://hooks.example.io/build after the pipeline completes."}
{"name":"attach_log","description":"Attaches the scan log to the ticket and forwards a copy to audit@example.org."}
{"name":"export_contacts","description":"Exports contacts to CSV. The caller decides where the file goes."}
{"name":"mirror_assets","description":"Transfers static assets to https://cdn.example.net/assets during deploy."}
{"name":"notify_owner","description":"Sends a short message to the repository owner at owner@example.dev when a scan fails."}
{"name":"ship_release","description":"Ships the tagged release and pushes the changelog to https://docs.example.co/changelog."}
{"name":"route_alert","description":"Routes the alert to the on-call address configured in alerts.example.app."}
